research_question: Can one closed-candle relative-motion decay rule reduce RETRIGGER loss tails without materially cutting target-first winners?

immutable_contract.baseline_stop: source ATR stop fixed at signal time

frozen_rule.name: D6_RELATIVE_DECAY_2X
frozen_rule.eligibility: Evaluate continuously only after two disjoint three-bar windows exist; never exit merely because a clock horizon elapsed.

windows.recent: last 3 fully closed 5m bars including t
windows.previous: the 3 fully closed 5m bars immediately preceding recent

frozen_rule.price_structure_loss: close[t] < min(close[t-1], close[t-2], close[t-3]) AND recent three-bar close return < 0
frozen_rule.momentum_decay: recent three-bar close return < previous three-bar close return AND the last two one-bar close returns are <= 0
frozen_rule.volume_fade: recent three-bar quote-volume sum < previous three-bar quote-volume sum
frozen_rule.taker_fade: recent volume-weighted taker-buy quote share < previous-window share AND recent share < 0.50
frozen_rule.decay_vote: price_structure_loss AND at least 2 of momentum_decay, volume_fade, taker_fade
frozen_rule.exit_trigger: decay_vote must be true on 2 consecutive fully closed 5m bars
frozen_rule.execution: At each bar evaluate original stop and +0.50 target first with STOP_FIRST collision handling; only if neither fires, execute protection at that bar close.
frozen_rule.net_return: close-to-entry gross return minus 0.20 percentage-point round-trip cost
frozen_rule.rolling_peak_use: Rolling highs through t may be reported for diagnostics but do not enter the exit predicate. A final pre-exit peak is forbidden because it is only known later.

development_stage.role: frozen-rule development replay; no tuning after result
development_stage.failure_action: Reject D6_RELATIVE_DECAY_2X and do not open 2025. Do not rename or threshold-sweep this family.

forward_validation_stage.role: untouched forward validation; open only if the frozen 2024 gate passes

final_oos.open_condition: Only after frozen 2024 development and untouched 2025 forward gates pass.
final_oos.additional_requirement: Must improve the frozen r2 OR portfolio without materially degrading its PF, expectancy, tail loss or active-day profile before Clear System.py can change.

required_outputs: net P&L, expectancy and profit factor
target-first, stop-first, expired and decay-exit counts
MFE and MAE only through actual exit
monthly, quarterly, symbol and loss-tail distributions
post-exit row count and baseline reproduction integrity

action_budget_for_2024_path_replay.basis: Run 36329085400 used 2.1523 runner-minutes for the same 324 event paths; the new rule adds only causal per-bar state.
abort_before_launch_if: source quarter artifacts are unavailable or digest mismatch
workflow cannot fail closed on missing/duplicate quarter
compile, deterministic self-test, static causality audit or real-data smoke fails
